== Title ==
<span lang="ja">帝国軍の正義</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：敵のほうが、自分より4以上多くフォースを起動できる場合に使用する。任意のロケーションに配備して、そのロケーションでのフォースの起動をキャンセルする。2：任意のロケーションに配備する。そのロケーションは「革命」の影響を受けなくなる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「ルーク、おまえがいたとて、どうにもならなかったろう。恐らくは一緒に殺されていた」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Imperial Justice]].

'''Lore''' — Luke, even if you had been there, it would have been no use. You would have been killed together.

'''Game text''' — Choose one. Use when the opponent can activate at least 4 more Force than you. Deploy on any location and cancel Force activation at that location. Or deploy on any location. That location is no longer affected by Revolution.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The Japanese title is 帝国軍の正義. Functions are numbered 1/2 instead of OR. The first function tests Force the opponent can activate, not Force generation, and does not say all generation. Revolution is 「革命」.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-imperialjustice.gif|Original English face]], [[Imperial Justice]].</ref>
